name: inner-datum
description: A co-op turn-based roguelike played inside a Discord voice channel, as a Discord Activity.
author: Dalton Barraclough

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.shared.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run check:secrets && npm run check:assets && npm run check:attribution
scripts.assets: python tools/gen_ui_assets.py && python tools/gen_content_assets.py && python tools/build_asset_manifest.py
scripts.assets:all: npm run assets:derive && npm run assets
